Done: solution.py is written in the problem directory with `class Solution` and `minimumCost`, implementing an O(n²) DP over subarray counts accelerated by a monotone convex-hull trick (lines with slopes -C[t] added in decreasing order, queried at increasing x = P[i] + k·j). All arithmetic uses integers (INF = 10³⁰) so the hull cross-multiplications stay exact.

Verification: `bash run_gate.sh` exits 0 with "GATE PASSED (2/2 public tests passed)" — confirmed multiple times, including after the final edit. I also cross-checked against an exponential brute force on 400+ random small cases (all matched) and measured n=1000 worst-case input at ~0.27s. Temporary files (`__pycache__`) were removed; problem.md, public_tests/, run_gate.sh, and gate.py were untouched.

Next step: none. Stopping now per AGENTS' termination rule since the gates are green.
